instruction: A short fluted marble column supporting a circular sundial plate tilted toward the sky. Veined white Carrara stone runs through the shaft with a carved acanthus band at the capital, and the bronze-toned gnomon casts a hard shadow across incised Roman numerals. Chipped edges and faint weather pitting suggest age without breaking the smooth polished planes.
